reports.title: BWX Technologies Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: BWXT reaffirmed its 2026 revenue guidance and tightened the ranges for its adjusted EBITDA(1),non-GAAP EPS(1), and free cash flow(1) guidance.

(In millions, except per share amounts) | Year Ended | Year Ending | Year Ending
December 31, 2025 | December 31, 2026 | December 31, 2026
Results | Current Guidance | Prior Guidance
Revenue | $3,198 | ~$3,800 | ~$3,800
Adjusted EBITDA(1) | $574 | ~$667 | $662 - $672
Non-GAAP(1) Earnings Per Share | $4.01 | $4.72 - $4.77 | $4.70 - $4.80
Free Cash Flow(1) | $295 | $350 - $360 | $345 - $360

Additional information can be found in the third quarter 2026 earnings call presentation on the BWXT investor relations website at www.bwxt.com/investors. The Company does not provide GAAP guidance because it is unable to reliably forecast most of the items that are excluded from GAAP to calculate non-GAAP results. These items could cause GAAP results to differ materially from non-GAAP results.
